from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,json,re,shutil,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/lucky/devdir/rgzndl')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from src.ect.paper_registration import _sources
from src.ect.paper_training import ARTIFACTS
folder=ROOT/'results/paper_training/runner_acceptance_v1'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
write=lambda p,v:Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',newline='\n')
_,sources=_sources()
review=json.loads(Path('/tmp/rgzndl_readonly_review_final.json').read_text())
assert review['result']=='no_reproducible_P1_P2_in_requested_scope'
assert review['code_sha256']==sources
shutil.copyfile('/tmp/rgzndl_readonly_review_final.json',folder/'independent_review.json')
helper=Path('/tmp/rgzndl_registration_readonly_review.py')
if helper.exists():
    text=helper.read_text()
    write(folder/'review_reproduction.json',dict(script=text,sha256=sha(helper)))
log=Path('/tmp/ect_paper_final_regression.log').read_text()
assert re.search(r'Ran 264 tests in 50\.993s',log) and log.rstrip().endswith('OK')
assert 'skipped' not in log and 'FAILED' not in log
(folder/'regression.log').write_text(log,newline='\n')
write(folder/'regression.json',dict(status='passed',test_count=264,skipped=0,elapsed_seconds=50.993,
    command='.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -v',
    execution_context='actual CUDA accessible',code_sha256=sources,log_sha256=sha(folder/'regression.log')))
runs=[]
files={}
for device in ('cpu','cuda'):
    run=folder/device
    report=json.loads((run/'report.json').read_text())
    proof_path=folder/f'{device}_verification.json'
    proof=json.loads(proof_path.read_text())
    assert report['status']=='complete' and report['sample_counts']=={'train':40,'validation':40}
    assert report['environment']['device']==device and report['parameter_update_l2']>0
    assert proof['status']=='verified' and proof['device']==device and proof['prediction_counts']==report['sample_counts']
    assert proof['report_sha256']==sha(run/'report.json') and proof['maximum_metric_error']<=1e-12
    for p in [run/'report.json',*[run/n for n in ARTIFACTS],proof_path]:
        files[p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()]=sha(p)
    runs.append(dict(device=device,run_dir=run.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),verification_path=proof_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()))
cpu_transfer=json.loads((folder/'cuda_cpu_verification.json').read_text())
assert cpu_transfer['status']=='verified' and cpu_transfer['device']=='cpu' and cpu_transfer['prediction_counts']=={'train':40,'validation':40}
for name in ('cuda_cpu_verification.json','regression.json','regression.log','independent_review.json','review_reproduction.json'):
    p=folder/name
    if p.exists(): files[p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()]=sha(p)
program=Path(__file__)
acceptance=dict(schema_version=1,status='verified',protocol='paper_baseline_runner_acceptance_v1',
    created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),test_classification_enabled=False,
    checks={k:True for k in ('cpu_training','cuda_training','independent_crop_reload','csv_metrics','full_regression','independent_code_review')},
    code_sha256=sources,files_sha256=files,runs=runs,
    cpu_transfer_verification_path=(folder/'cuda_cpu_verification.json').relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
    note='40 train/40 validation, 2 epochs: implementation/device acceptance only, not a performance comparison.',
    execution_script=dict(text=program.read_text(),sha256=sha(program)))
output=folder/'acceptance.json'
assert not output.exists()
write(output,acceptance)
print(json.dumps(dict(status='verified',sha256=sha(output),files=len(files))))
